Message: /* select#1 */ select `ep2_lab`.`i`.`product_id` AS `product_id`,`ep2_lab`.`p`.`product_name` AS `product_name`,sum(`ep2_lab`.`i`.`qty`) AS `unidades` from `ep2_lab`.`ep2_orders` `o` join `ep2_lab`.`ep2_order_items` `i` join `ep2_lab`.`ep2_products` `p` where ((`ep2_lab`.`i`.`order_id` = `ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_id`) and (`ep2_lab`.`p`.`product_id` = `ep2_lab`.`i`.`product_id`) and (cast(`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` as date) >= <cache>(cast((@`start_ts`) as date))) and (cast(`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` as date) < <cache>(cast((@`end_ts`) as date))) and (`ep2_lab`.`o`.`status` <> 'CANCELLED')) group by `ep2_lab`.`i`.`product_id` order by `unidades` desc,`ep2_lab`.`i`.`product_id` limit 20
